name: Corki
notes: Corki enters the fight with a full 4-charge Missile Barrage stock (the reasonable in-game state for a champion who has been out of combat) and fires the opening R at t=0, using the engine's default opening cast; the fixed 2 s fire cooldown plus a single 20 s-per-charge (ability-haste-scaled) recharge timer refill R for the rest of the fight, exactly as its stocking mechanic describes.

Every basic attack against the (champion-counted) dummy reduces R's remaining recharge time by 2 to 6 s scaling with crit chance, per Missile Barrage's on-hit passive; this is applied on every on-hit application an attack produces, so it can double with items that apply on-hit effects twice.

Missile Barrage's damage does not proc Eclipse's execute passive, per the wiki's explicit note, so eclipse_hit() is skipped only for R; it still triggers Malignance's post-ult amplification like any ultimate.
Every third missile fired is a Big One dealing double damage; the counter starts at zero when the fight begins.
Hextech Munitions' bonus true damage (20% total AD, crit-affected) rides every basic attack as an on-hit rider, applied once per on-hit application (so it can also double with Rageblade-style items).
Q, W and E are cast the instant each comes off cooldown; Corki keeps auto-attacking throughout, including through Gatling Gun's channel, since nothing states the channel blocks his attacks.

Valkyrie's damage is modeled as landing on a single stationary target with one fire patch beneath it (its full 5 ticks over 2.5 s), rather than assuming all three possible patches overlap a single point; this is the more conservative and more common single-target reading of an ability whose extra patches depend on dash distance.
Gatling Gun's cooldown starts on cast (not when its 4 s channel ends), per the wiki's explicit cdstart note.

Gatling Gun's flat per-stack armor/magic resistance shred (3 to 5 per stack, up to 4 stacks) is not modeled: the engine's shred mechanic only supports a percentage reduction, and this is a flat value that cannot be converted to one without knowing the target's base resistances ahead of time; omitting it makes E's own later ticks (and everything else) a slight underestimate.

The reported bug where true damage is skipped if the target already died to the on-hit/physical portion of the same attack is not modeled; it only matters at the exact moment a target dies and has negligible effect on total damage dealt to a dummy over the fight.
Mana is not modeled; Corki is assumed to have enough mana (through runes/items/regen) to keep casting through the short simulated fight.

assumed.why: a level 16 Corki who has been out of combat plausibly has a full 4-charge Missile Barrage stock rather than the 2 charges granted only at the moment R is first learned
